package stmts

run :: proc(xs: []int, u: Value, m: map[string]int) -> (err: Error) {
    if x := len(xs); x > 0 {
        return
    } else if x < 0 {
    } else do return

    when ODIN_DEBUG {
    }

    for i := 0; i < 10; i += 1 {}
    for x in xs {}
    for x, i in xs {}
    for i in 0 ..< 10 {}
    for i in 0 ..= 10 {}
    for {
        break
    }
    #reverse for x in xs {}
    #unroll for i in 0 ..< 4 {}

    switch x := 1; x {
    case 1, 2:
        fallthrough
    case 3 ..< 5:
    case:
    }
    switch v in u {
    case int:
    case f64, string:
    }
    #partial switch Color.Red {
    case .Red:
    }

    outer: for x in xs {
        inner: for y in xs {
            if y == 0 do continue outer
            break inner
        }
    }

    defer cleanup()
    defer {
        cleanup()
    }
    using point: Point
    using point

    value := may_fail() or_return
    for {
        next() or_break
        next() or_continue
    }
    fallback := lookup() or_else 0

    #no_bounds_check {
        _ = xs[0]
    }
    context = runtime.default_context()
    context.allocator = context.temp_allocator
    x, y := 1, 2
    x, y = y, x
    x += 1
    {
        nested := 1
    }
    return .None
}
